en.description:
Block Blast for Watch — Your New Wrist-Worn Block Puzzle Adventure!
Key Features
Intuitive Touch Controls
Optimized for your Apple Watch: simply tap and drag shapes right on the watch face—no phone needed.
Play Anywhere, Anytime
Fully offline—jump into a quick round on the subway, in line, or during a coffee break.
Rhythmic Sound & Feedback
Crisp effects and pulsing beats make every line clear feel satisfyingly rhythmic.
Stress-Relieving Fun
Perfect for a moment of calm: clear blocks to unwind, boost your mood, and banish boredom.
How to Play

Select & Place
Choose from the upcoming block shapes in the bottom panel and drag them onto the 10×10 grid.
Clear Lines
Fill any row or column completely to explode blocks, earn points, and free up space.
New Shapes Incoming
After each clear, a fresh set of blocks appears—plan ahead to keep your board tidy!
Strategize for High Scores
Think several moves ahead, anticipate shape patterns, and maximize clears for the ultimate challenge.
Download Block Blast on your Apple Watch today—wearable puzzle fun that fits right on your wrist!
en.subtitle: Block Puzzle Stress Relief
